model_annotation: This plot illustrates a comparison among five different model configurations, specifically StrmLLM and several SepLLM variants, tracking their trajectories across an unspecified domain. The x-axis is indicated by evenly spaced vertical grid lines, while the y-axis is indicated by evenly spaced horizontal grid lines. However, both axes are entirely devoid of labels, numeric tick marks, defined value ranges, and units, making it impossible to ascertain precise beginning and ending values or confirm the scale types. The plot features five solid lines without marker shapes, and each line is surrounded by a lighter, semi-transparent shaded band of the same color indicating variance or noise. Every line demonstrates the same general behavior: a steep, nearly vertical drop on the extreme left side of the plot, which quickly transitions into a long, continuous, and highly gradual downward curve stretching toward the right edge. In terms of their relative vertical positioning after the initial drop, the blue line, labeled "StrmLLM (n=64)", tracks the highest path. It is followed below by the orange line representing "SepLLM (n=64)". Just marginally beneath the orange line is the green line for "SepLLM (n=64, H)". Further down is the red line, corresponding to "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)". The lowest curve displayed on the graph is the purple line, which represents "SepLLM (n=128)".
